## Safety
- [ ] This PR does not push directly to main.
- [ ] This PR does not change GitHub Pages settings.
- [ ] This PR does not change pricing.

- [ ] This PR does not change reviews or achievements.
- [ ] This PR does not change official LINE / Instagram / note URLs.

## Conversion flow check

- [ ] Free diagnostic checklist still works.
- [ ] Diagnostic result modal still works.
- [ ] 90-day program section is present.

- [ ] FAQ is present.

- [ ] Instagram link works.
- [ ] note link works.

## Mobile check
- [ ] First view looks correct on mobile.
- [ ] Text is readable on mobile.
- [ ] Images are displayed correctly.
- [ ] Buttons are tappable.
- [ ] No major layout break is visible.
